files.prompt_en: A full-body character sprite for a hand-painted fantasy exploration RPG. One adult swordsman consulting about an old magical wound that preserves a lost companion's voice. Short dark chestnut hair, a thoughtful tired face, a restrained attentive expression, natural adult proportions. Standing in a relaxed three-quarter view, wearing a muted slate-blue long-sleeved tunic, a worn brown sleeveless leather jacket, plain belt, dark trousers and sturdy leather boots. The clothed torso and sleeves keep the wound private. Both hands are empty and relaxed beside the body. His posture suggests careful listening and personal resolve. The complete person and clothes form a crisp readable silhouette, with softly painted textures and warm directional light. Center the entire figure on a 1024 by 1536 portrait canvas with head, hands and boot tips fully framed and generous transparent margins. The entire surrounding canvas is transparent.
files.prompt_ja: 手描き探索RPG用の全身立ち絵。亡き仲間の声を残す魔法傷の治療を相談する成人の剣士が一人。短い暗栗色の髪、疲れと思慮を帯びた顔、落ち着いて相手を見る表情と自然な体の比率。石板青色の長袖上衣、使い込んだ茶色の革の胴着、簡素な帯、暗いズボン、丈夫な革のブーツ。胴と袖は衣服に覆われ、傷を本人の内に保つ。両手は空にして体の横へ自然に下ろす。よく聞き、自分で決める意志を姿勢ににじませる。柔らかな筆触と温かな斜光、明瞭な人物の輪郭。1024×1536の縦長画面の中央に頭・手・靴先まで全身を収め、周囲に透明の余白を取る。背景全体は透明。
